name: Claude Code Subagents
headline: Dynamic AI sub-agent team assembly
short_description: Claude Code SubAgents creates a dynamic AI development team tailored to your tech stack. Operations teams use it to automate coding tasks, integrate with existing workflows, and improve productivity. It connects to Claude Code and other Python-based tools.
author: mylee04

sections.overview:
Claude Code SubAgents provides 31 specialized AI agents organized by expertise—from Python and DevOps to security and data engineering—that work together like a coordinated development team. Each agent levels up through a gamification system, earning XP and achievements as you use them, with an intelligent registry that automatically discovers and recommends the right agent combinations for your project needs. The system handles agent coordination through Claude Code's built-in orchestration, eliminating the need for manual workflow setup. Operations teams use SubAgents to automate complex coding tasks, integrate with existing workflows, and improve productivity by leveraging domain-specific expertise rather than generic AI assistance. Setup takes 10 seconds with a single git clone command into the Claude directory.
Automating multi-language code optimization and refactoring across Python, JavaScript, Go, and Rust projects
Coordinating incident response and production troubleshooting with DevOps and security agents
Building complete system architectures with team recommendations for full-stack applications
Automated code review, testing strategy, and quality assurance workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mylee04/claude-code-subagents`
sections.usage:
```
Create a team of 3 Claude Code SubAgents for a [PROJECT_NAME] using [TECH_STACK]. Assign each agent a specific role (e.g., frontend, backend, testing) and describe their responsibilities. Include how they will collaborate with each other and integrate with [EXISTING_WORKFLOW].
```
